title: Dam ba dam ali ali pukar
body:
Dam badam ali ali pukaar
har qadam ali ali pukaar
tere sune aangan me khilegi bahaar
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Dar badar bhathakne ka kyun ye rog paala hai
sab ke sab bhikaari hain kon dene waala hai
un se maang oo'nton ki dede jo qataar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Paak hai lahu kis ka kis mein kya kharaabi hai
kon hai saqifaayi kon buturaabi hai
pal me sab ke chehro'n se hoga aashkaar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. aal ki taraf gar tu ek qadam badhayega
das qadam zamaane se khud ko aage paayega
kyun ke ye nahi rakhte kisi ka udhaar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ranj o gham ki raaho'n me bad hawaas betha hai
chal ali ki chokhat par kyun udaas betha hai
bas palak jhapakte hi hoga bedaa paar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Naam e faatahe khaibar gar tera vazifa hai
dur hogi har mushkil ye hamaara daava hai
khaali jaa nahi sakta tera koyi vaar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Chaahta hai gar tujhse Sayyada bhi raazi ho
khush ho khaaliq e akbar Mustafa bhi raazi ho
munkiraan e haidar pe karde beshumaar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tujhko fatema zehra ki duaayein mil jaaye
khud teri ziyaarat ko ambiya chale aayein
karbala pahonch jaaye tu jo ek baar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Adl aur adaalat ka intezaam lene ko
karbala ka ay nayaab inteqaam lene ko
aane waala hai koyi leke zulfiqaar
